1. When do you play Cats Guidance?

before combat begins or after combat (to untap after blocking)

2. Bums Rush

If minion A uses Bums Rush on minion B and minion C blocked it...
Does the methuselah get to replace Bums Rush? I dont think so but...

Messages.Author: Tim Eijpe
Messages.Body:
In article <91v6pk$s0k$1...@nnrp1.deja.com>,

mads...@my-deja.com wrote:
> 1. When do you play Cats Guidance?
>
> before combat begins or after combat (to untap after blocking)

At the end of combat, meaning after the conclusion of an action that was
successfully blocked and the resulting combat.
Effectively this means directly after the combat, before any new
blockable actions.

> 2. Bums Rush
>
> If minion A uses Bums Rush on minion B and minion C blocked it...
> Does the methuselah get to replace Bums Rush? I dont think so but...

Yes, it can be replaced. Whenever an card-based action is blocked, it
should be replaced as the action is not successful. It does not matter
which minion blocks the action.

>
> 3. Brainwash
>
> It says no transfers may be made TO the vampire...does that mean the
> methuselah can still get his blood back?
>

Brainwash [Jyhad, V:TES]
Cardtype: Master
Master. Put this card on a <vampire in your Prey's uncontrolled region>.
No more transfers can be made to that vampire. Any minion may burn this
card as a +1 stealth action.

The cardtext does not prohibit transferring off the uncontrolled
vampire, so yes you can get your pool back.

Tim Eijpe <t_e...@my-deja.com> wrote:
> mads...@my-deja.com wrote:
> > 1. When do you play Cats Guidance?
> >
> > before combat begins or after combat (to untap after blocking)
>
> At the end of combat, meaning after the conclusion of an action that
> was successfully blocked and the resulting combat.
> Effectively this means directly after the combat

Correct.

> > 2. Bums Rush
> >
> > If minion A uses Bums Rush on minion B and minion C blocked it...
> > Does the methuselah get to replace Bums Rush? I dont think so but...
>
> Yes, it can be replaced. Whenever an card-based action is blocked, it
> should be replaced as the action is not successful. It does not matter
> which minion blocks the action.

No. Bum's Rush (and Arson, for that matter) are not replaced if
blocked until after the action (after the combat).

> > 3. Brainwash
> >
> > It says no transfers may be made TO the vampire...does that mean the
> > methuselah can still get his blood back?
>

> The cardtext does not prohibit transferring off the uncontrolled
> vampire, so yes you can get your pool back.

No. See the online rulings:

* Transfers may not be made to the vampire - neither to put blood
on nor to move blood off. [RTR 19950413]
